content.title: CG (Commercial, General) District
content.summary: The CG (Commercial, General) District is designed to support a diverse range of retail, service, and professional office uses, primarily located along major roads with high traffic access. Various use classifications are permitted, including by-right, limited, and conditional uses, with specific regulations outlined in the Land Development Code for each category, such as residential, hospitality, commercial, and institutional uses. If a use is not specified in the regulations, it is not permitted within this zoning district.
content.body:
Intended to accommodate a wide variety of general retail and service uses, as well as professional and business offices serving both neighborhood and area-wide needs. These zones are typically located along arterial streets, or where other appropriate high-volume vehicular access is available.

Acronyms:

- Allowed Use By-Right (A)
- Limited Use (L)
- Conditional Use (C)

**Note**: If a use is not listed in the table then it is not allowed in the zoning district
